Monday, October 12

Activity 1: Load NSA non-farm payroll employment and create a “tsibble”

A) Create a new R-script (call it something you will remember and save it somewhere you can find later.)

B) Load the required packages:

library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)

C) Next load U.S. non-farm payroll employment (not seasonally adjusted) from FRED (note - it is a "Q" in tq_get below):

emp_raw <- tq_get(
c("PAYNSA"),
get = "economic.data",
from = "1976-01-01"
)

D) Now rename the columns:

emp <- emp_raw |>
mutate(Month = yearmonth(date), employment = price) |>
select(Month, employment)

E) Turn the data into a “time series tibble” – called a “tsibble”:

emp <- emp |>
as_tsibble(index = Month)

F) View the first few rows of your tsibble

head(emp)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
